frequency_question: How often do major economies successfully sign negotiated comprehensive trade frameworks once high-level political intent is established?
membership_rule: Includes bilateral trade negotiations initiated between major economic blocs (e.g., EU, US, India, Japan, Mercosur) that reached advanced text-finalisation stages. Excludes minor technical updates or non-binding declarations.
provenance_note: 6 cases named, 8 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.3x)
coverage_note: 6 named; believed roughly 8 comparable major structured negotiations in total within the period
known_gaps: Excludes stalled or ongoing negotiations where intent was ambiguous from the outset.
skeleton: Completed significant bilateral trade agreements by major actors divided by initiated major trade negotiations meeting high-level intent thresholds
multiplier: 6 hits out of 8 comparable advanced-stage negotiations tracked in baseline reference class
validity_reason: Global trade negotiation architectures and political appetites for bilateral pacts remain relatively stable over multi-year horizons.
